draft.subject: Applied for Computer Vision Engineer, edge AI background
draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas and I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied for the Computer Vision Engineer opening at Pano AI and wanted to reach out to you directly.

I line up with what the posting asks for. My degree is in one of the listed fields, my internship and research work covers the experience range, and I use Python and PyTorch on Linux regularly. On the preferred side I have deployed vision models on NVIDIA Jetson using TensorRT and ONNX, trained object detection and semantic segmentation models, and written CUDA kernels to cut inference time.

I noticed this role and a senior computer vision opening went up the same day, so the vision team looks like it is growing. I would like to be in the mix while that is happening.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
draft.hook_used: Team scaling signal: entry and senior CV reqs posted the same day
